Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/34919

Problem Summary:

there are some functions to operate ddl jobs like `GetHistoryDDLJob` which is a method of meta, it is not easy to change the implementation because every caller should build a meta for it. So, wrapping them in another will be better.

review_comments: Why are we doing this?  I don't feel like this is necessary
well, it is like an entrance of "get all ddl jobs", it now gets from `meta`, in the future, we may add another way to get them and use a switch to control it.
I think this can be changed in the future, there's no need to add the function of `getDDLJobs`.
